correctness.rationale: For fixed marked set P with k=|P| and N=n-k, each unmarked vertex independently has one of two disjoint extreme arc signatures of probability t=2^-k. Hence (A,B,N-A-B) is exactly multinomial(t,t,1-2t). The unused cross-arc variables are independent fair bits, so H|A,B ~ Bin(AB,1/2), and N t->lambda gives independent Poisson(lambda) counts. In rank two, the complete two-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraisse invariant is the set of color/orientation profiles. With k->infinity and N->infinity, only the optional A-present and B-present profiles survive, yielding twelve subset-sum limits on dyadic n=2^m,k=m. The rank-three χ is exactly H>0; its limiting probability h(1)=1-E[2^-AB]≈0.289156 is strictly between e^-1(1-e^-1) and e^-1, an empty adjacent rank-two interval. Algebraic endpoint bounds and the EF characterization were independently checked. An independent exact multinomial normalization and χ limit computation corroborated formulas, not infinite completeness.
